```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(knitr)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(e1071)
library(caret)
library(FNN)
library(here)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

def.chunk.hook  <- knitr::knit_hooks$get("chunk")
knitr::knit_hooks$set(chunk = function(x, options) {
  x <- def.chunk.hook(x, options)
  paste0("\n \\", "footnotesize","\n\n", x, "\n\n \\normalsize")
})

knitr::opts_chunk$set(comment = "") # removes ##

setwd(here()) # sets path to root of RProject

# Part 1A cleaning code
pos <- read.csv("FieldingPost.csv")
batting <- read.csv("batting.csv")

stats <- merge(batting, pos[, c("playerID", "POS")],
               by = "playerID", all.x = TRUE)# add positions

stats_clean <- stats[stats$lgID == "AL" |
                    stats$lgID == "NL", ] # focuses on American and National League

stats_clean <- stats_clean[!is.na(stats_clean$POS), ]  # removes batting data without positions

stats_clean$BA <- ifelse(stats_clean$AB > 0, stats_clean$H /
                           stats_clean$AB, NA)

by_team <- aggregate(cbind(G, AB, R, H, HR, RBI, SB, BB, SO) ~ teamID + yearID,
                      data = stats_clean, FUN = sum) 
# adds Batting Average
by_team$BA <- by_team$H / by_team$AB

# rename positions 
position_names <- c(
  "1B" = "First Base",
  "2B" = "Second Base",
  "3B" = "Third Base",
  "C"  = "Catcher",
  "CF" = "Center Field",
  "LF" = "Left Field",
  "P"  = "Pitcher",
  "RF" = "Right Field",
  "SS" = "Shortstop"
)

by_team_pos <- aggregate(cbind(AB, H, HR, BB, SO, BA) ~ teamID + POS, data = stats_clean, FUN = sum)  
by_team_pos$Position <- position_names[by_team_pos$POS]

# loading in code from part B
source("Group17_Exercise1B.R")
```

## Hits vs Home Runs

```{r hits_hr, echo=FALSE, fig.width=5, fig.height=3}
ggplot(by_team, aes(x = H, y = HR)) +
  geom_point(col = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    x = "Hits",
    y = "Home Runs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Hits Across Teams by Position
```{r hits_pos, echo=FALSE, fig.width=5, fig.height=3}
ggplot(by_team_pos, aes(x = Position, y = H)) +
  geom_boxplot(col = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    x = "Position",
    y = "Hits"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
final_comp <- data.frame(
  Metric  = c("Log-Loss", "Brier Score", "Balanced Accuracy (Macro)", "Macro-F1"),
  NoSkill = round(null_base[c("LogLoss", "Brier", "BalAcc", "MacroF1")], 4),
  kNN     = round(test_metrics[c("LogLoss", "Brier", "BalAcc", "MacroF1")], 4),
  NB      = round(nb_metrics[c("LogLoss", "Brier", "BalAcc", "MacroF1")], 4)
)
names(final_comp) <- c("Metric", "No-Skill", paste0("kNN (k* = ", k_star, ")"), "Naive Bayes")
tbl(final_comp, "Test-set comparison of the no-skill baseline, kNN, and Naive Bayes.")
```

## Calibration Plot
```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.width=5, fig.height=3}
ggplot(calib, aes(x = mean_p, y = frac_obs, color = Model)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("steelblue", "lightcoral")) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.5, 5), name = "Predictions in bin") +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Mean predicted probability",
       y = "Observed fraction of true class") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "right", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```
